name: MonkeyAI
tagline: AI API access for apps, coding tools and agents
description: MonkeyAI is an AI API relay platform for applications, coding tools and agent workflows. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API entry point to models including GPT, Claude, DeepSeek and image models, together with API key management, usage records and balance-based billing. Public English and Chinese documentation explains how to choose a protocol and configure clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cherry Studio and OpenAI SDKs. Billing is prepaid and pay-as-you-go: a top-up funds the account balance for API usage, there is no fixed monthly or annual subscription, no automatic renewal and no recurring charge, and customers initiate another top-up when more balance is needed. Model pricing is shown in ¥ per 1M tokens with input, output and cache reads priced separately, and the applicable rate depends on the selected account group. Available models, supported capabilities and pricing are shown on the public pricing page and in the account console.
